_comment: Per-item manual position nudges for swf_to_spritesheet.py. Applied on top of whatever the item's slot formula computes -- use this when one specific item doesn't fit the formula, not as a replacement for the formula. See the ANCHOR_OVERRIDES_PATH comment in swf_to_spritesheet.py for the full story.
_format: item_id: {"dx": N, "dy": N} applies to every frame; "dirs": {"<direction>": {"dx": N, "dy": N, "frames": {"<n>": {"dx": N, "dy": N}}}} adds on top for one direction, optionally down to one stop(n=0)/walk(n=1) pose ("bas" items only -- milieu/hat/hair have one frame per direction, no frames level). Each level ADDS on top of the ones above it. Units: 3x-canvas px.
